title: Plausibly-exogenous bounds for average partial and interaction effects — apexog
text: formula Two-sided formula y ~ x1 + x2 0/1 outcome exogenous controls (factors interactions allowed; use y ~ 1 controls).  constant always included. endog Two-sided formula d ~ z1 + z2 (endogenous regressor(s) left, excluded instruments right), list formulas, one per group endogenous regressors sharing instrument set (Stata's multi-clause syntax).  endogenous interaction treatment moderator written left d + d:x, instruments right (e.g. d + d:x ~ z + z:x); combine aie = c("d", "x"). data data frame. method "uci" "ltz". gmin, gmax UCI: lower upper end assumed \(\gamma\) range, one value per instrument single value (broadcast). grid UCI: number grid points per instrument (default 11). mu, omega LTZ, Gaussian prior: mean variance instrument's \(\gamma\) (single values broadcast). prior LTZ prior.  "normal" (default; uses mu omega unless prior_params given), one "uniform", "chi2", "t", "gamma", "poisson", "special" (parameters prior_params), function function(n) returning n x K matrix draws. prior_params List one parameter vector per instrument (one, broadcast): normal c(mean, sd), uniform c(min, max), chi2 df, t df, gamma c(shape, scale), poisson mean, special: numeric donor vector sampled replacement. draws Optional iterations x K matrix \(\gamma\) draws (gunits) used instead prior, e.g. joint prior . Passing Stata's e(gamma_sim) (latent units, default gunits = "latent") reproduces Stata LTZ run draw draw; convolution noise differs. iterations LTZ: number prior draws (default 1000). seed Optional seed passed set.seed() drawing. firststage First-stage model: "linear" (default), "probit" (0/1 regressor, generalized residual), "fprobit" (fractional regressor), "poisson" (count), "biprobit" (recursive bivariate probit single 0/1 regressor; exact joint normality).  single value applies every endogenous regressor, including declared interaction d:x (needs "linear"); otherwise give one value per endogenous regressor, order appearance, named vector (unnamed regressors default "linear"), e.g. c(d = "probit"). target Character vector endogenous regressors whose APE bounds reported (default: ). aie Character vector c(X, Z): switch target average interaction effect X Z.  must exogenous control column endogenous regressor (use numeric 0/1 variables, factor()).  product X:Z declared endogenous regressor (endog = d + d:x ~ ...) regressor target; otherwise product taken formula written x:z x*z, added exogenous control.  write (x*z): detected duplicate refused. aie_binary Logical length-2 vector forcing type X Z (TRUE = binary, FALSE = continuous, NA = detect data).  Continuous x continuous gives cross-partial, continuous x binary first difference slope, binary x binary second discrete difference. cfinteract Add products control functions main probit (cfprobit's cfinteract).  Automatic declared endogenous interaction. gunits Units user-supplied \(\gamma\) values: "latent" (probit-index units; default), "pr" (probability points, divided \(m_\phi\), average density baseline fit), "structural" (structural-latent units, divided \(\tilde\sigma\); derived linear first stage).  structural conversion uses baseline \(\tilde\sigma\), exact \(\gamma = 0\).  one continuous endogenous regressor, one instrument linear first stage, structural value unique index-scale counterpart \(|\pi_z|/\sigma_v\) absolute value (returned gs_max); print reports limit warns UCI box LTZ prior draws reach .  0/1 regressor linear first stage conversion derived print warns instead.  Results changed. level Confidence level, fraction percent (default 0.95). cluster Optional cluster identifier: one-sided formula (~ id), column name, vector length nrow(data). subset Optional logical expression evaluated data. Observations NA dropped (Stata's treats missing value +Inf may keep ). sweep_omega, sweep_mu, sweep_delta LTZ, Gaussian prior: rerun simulation prior variance sweep_omega (means sweep_mu, default 0; x-axis labels sweep_delta, default variances) store bounds-versus-width table $sweep. verbose Print notes fitting (default TRUE).
